svg.title: AladdinAI — the story
svg.desc: An animated story in six scenes. A small hero built from the AladdinAI logo mark runs down the page: one-command install with npx aladdin-ai; adding your own server over SSH so BentoML installs itself; sandboxed agents with no network, no delete tool and human-approved terminal commands; traces that become a golden set; keyless web search with a real browser; and Word documents that agents edit as tagged text with versions. My AI agents. My infrastructure. My rules.
svg.text: My AI agents. My infrastructure. My rules.
Open-source AI agent platform. Connect your own servers
and models, then manage everything from the UI.
scroll down · the story is below
No clone, no config files. Node and Docker, that is all.
Add it over SSH. BentoML installs itself, ports sort themselves.
Sandboxed. No network. Can't delete. Terminal waits for you.
Rate it, and the good ones become your own training set.

svg.text: DuckDuckGo, Wikipedia, arXiv, News — plus a real browser.
Word in, plain tags for the agent, Word out. Every save is a version.
Your data. Your models. Your rules.
